title: Lamb Shift of a Static Atom Facing a Rotating Surface
summary: We study how the Lamb shift of a static atom is modified when a nearby planar body rotates rigidly about its normal while the atom is held at a fixed distance $a$. We derive a general formula for the shift in terms of the angularly Doppler-shifted reflection coefficients of the surface, valid for any axially symmetric planar material. Expanding the result to second order in the angular velocity $Ω$, we identify two independent contributions associated with the orbital and spin components of the electromagnetic angular momentum.
